title: GrooveShop Payments Business Config
description: Configuration a business advertises for the space.grooveshop.payments handler at /.well-known/ucp. The handler needs no processor identity or key material: nothing is charged through it, so there is no credential to authenticate and no secret to publish.

environment.description: Which of the business's environments this declaration describes. Platforms use it to keep test traffic out of live order flow.
